ns2:course.label: Behavioral Finance
ns2:course.description: There is increasing evidence that the financial decisions of at least some investors are affected by various behavioral biases that do not follow from traditional portfolio choice models. This course will highlight and analyze key findings from this research and consider implications of this observed behavior for individual investors and money managers. The results are also of interest for managers of firms and human resource departments. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Restricted to MSF and MBA Students.
